title: Watchouts
slide_intent: Teach designers to distinguish a reproducible identity symbol from a drawing anyone may make in a participatory setting. Official uses depend on a stable silhouette.
strategic_value: Frontline AIDS can invite informal expressions of the figure while keeping its supplied mark identifiable in formal communications.
demonstration: Nine prohibited examples change the head, orientation, color, effects, construction or surroundings of the person. Each is paired with a pink cross.
practical_value: Check the official asset for distortion, superimposed facial features, poor contrast and additions before release.

content_islands.name: Scope note
content_islands.spec: Identify this as the symbol subsection in the rail and put the caution under Watchouts at left.

content_islands.name: Alteration examples
content_islands.spec: Arrange three rows of standalone figures with short diagnoses. Include the examples of recoloring, outlining, rotating and adding a shadow.

content_islands.name: Image and redraw cases
content_islands.spec: Use the face inside the symbol, the altered construction and the symbol on a photograph to clarify the limits on formal reproduction.
